name: Umbris
description: A spirit bound by the sorcerer Taivas in the keep who takes the townsfolk's fears and sorrows each night and possesses Aleksandar's body.

timeline.summary: Torens and Eruth descend through a bone-lined ossuary of captured memories and find Aleksandar's body possessed by Umbris.
Umbris explains that the sorcerer Taivas bound him to take the villagers' sorrows in exchange for tribute victims, and reveals that he took Aleksandar's memory of his sister.
timeline.quote: The anguish he felt at discovering the corpse of his young sister is . . . delectable.

timeline.summary: Umbris tempts Torens to give up his pain and walk away in exchange for purpose and rewards.
timeline.quote: "Allow me to take your pain away and give you purpose.

timeline.summary: Torens strikes the binding circle with his mace, freeing Umbris, and then makes a proposal to him.
timeline.quote: When the head of the mace met the binding circle, the impact sent a thunderclap pealing throughout the catacomb

timeline.summary: Umbris leaves Aleksandar's body, and Torens comforts the boy as the mob stones Vytas.
timeline.quote: Umbris relinquished control of Aleksandar, who collapsed into Torens's arms.

relations.quote: In exchange, Taivas's lineage furnishes me with what I need.

pages_say.description: A spirit bound by the sorcerer Taivas in the keep who takes the townsfolk's fears and sorrows each night and possesses Aleksandar's body.
